values.value: MCN Consent & Custom Preferences is a Spring '26+ capability and its parity with what you run today is unverified. With permission state this entangled, the preference-centre rebuild must not sit on the critical path: bridge it on the current platform and rebuild after parity is confirmed against a real tenant. Plan 2-4 weeks for a custom consent model on top of the foundation estimate.
